6.8 Mastering the Cross Collar Choke fro.overview: A 29-lesson gi course (about 2 hours) on the cross collar choke from top positions, taught in a seminar style with Q&A and 'mat chat' sections; the instructor isn't named in the files. It builds the choke from mount with the underhand and then the overhand grip, taking the slack out of the collar, staying stable while attacking, posting the head to finish, and clearing the defending hands. It then covers finishing when the opponent turns or blocks, using the legs to control from mount, both angles of attack, and the low mount (feet together versus grapevines). Follow-ups include the armbar (keeping the hip connected, dealing with a bicep frame) and the americana when they defend. Later lessons cover the choke from knee on belly (and when to go there), from cross side, from top half guard, Roger Gracie's version from mount, and dealing with an opponent who keeps bumping.
6.8 Mastering the Cross Collar Choke fro.for: Gi players who want the cross collar choke as their main top finish; ideal for a mount-and-choke game.
